calls.title: Dessault & GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion focused on GrowthBook’s capabilities in enhancing personalization and experimentation for Dassault, including insights from a proof of concept (POC) aimed at optimizing user journeys on 3DS.com. Participants emphasized the importance of understanding technical integration, particularly how user data links to experiment variants and backend interactions. Further, Dassault's reliance on BigQuery for analytics and the need for cost optimization in querying were highlighted, alongside a comparison of GrowthBook’s competitive advantages, such as its all-in-one licensing model. The team underscored the significance of empowering non-technical users to execute experiments independently and the added benefits of enterprise features, including governance and security. Next steps involved scheduling a demo to showcase usability and scaling capabilities and planning additional discussions on data architecture integration.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Experimentation, Personalization, BigQuery, Data Warehouse, AI Features
